elements.description: Times in text, underlined: hover or focus one to see it in your own time zone.

properties.name: text
properties.description: The text to find times in: plain text, shown as written (line breaks kept)

properties.name: date
properties.description: The day times written without a date fall on, "YYYY-MM-DD"; by default today in the zone each is written in

properties.name: now
properties.description: The time now, epoch ms – today is taken from it when `date` isn't given; by default the element's own clock

properties.name: timeZone
properties.description: The reader's time zone, an IANA name such as "Europe/Berlin"; by default the browser's

properties.name: locale
properties.description: The language for times and dates, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

properties.name: hoverDelay
properties.description: How long the pointer rests on a time before its tooltip opens, ms

properties.name: labels
properties.description: The words the tooltip uses, merged over the defaults

properties.name: times
properties.description: The times found in `text`, in order

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: A tooltip opened or closed ({ open }: TimeOpenChange; null when closed)

methods.name: openCard
methods.description: Opens the tooltip for the time at `index` in `times`, pinned open

methods.name: closeCard
methods.description: Closes the open tooltip, if any

functions.name: timeZoneAbbreviations
functions.description:
The zone names it reads: a fixed offset in minutes, or an IANA zone for names that follow daylight saving. IST,
AST and others that name several zones are left out, so they're never converted wrongly.

functions.name: findTimes
functions.description:
Every time with a zone in `text`, in order, with the instant it means. Times without a date fall on `date`
("YYYY-MM-DD"), or on today (from `now`) in the zone they're written in.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the time whose tooltip opened, or null when it closed

changelog: **Time Details** (`tc-time-details`): times in a passage of text, found and underlined – hover or focus one and a tooltip shows it in the reader's own zone (“Your local time · 1:00 AM EST”), with the weekday and date when the day changes (“Saturday, 7 November · The day before”). It reads 24- and 12-hour times with a zone (“06:00 UTC”, “6 PM ET”, “14:00 GMT+1”, “06:00Z”), ISO stamps, an ISO date before a time, and ranges (“05:30–09:00 UTC”); ET, CT, MT and PT follow daylight saving. Times without a date fall on `date` or today; the reader's zone is the browser's, or `time-zone`. Each time is described by its local time for screen readers. Also exported: `findTimes()`.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: inert
features.why: Closed and leaving parts are out of the tab order and hidden from screen readers.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: Popover API
features.without: Lists open fixed to the window instead of in the top layer, so a clipping ancestor or a modal can cover them.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
